title: UsageGuru · Get more out of Claude. Spend less doing it.
excerpt: Up to 90% fewer tokens on logs and stack traces. Your Claude limits last longer and your API bill shrinks.

How it works

Install once. Your AI does the rest.

1

Add it to your AI tool

Paste one command or config block with the license key you get after checkout. That's the whole setup. Needs Node.js 20+.

$ claude mcp add usage-guru -e USAGEGURU_LICENSE_KEY=your-key -- npx -y usage-guru

2

Claude reads logs through it

When Claude opens a big log or build output, it uses compress_file and gets the short version. To paste something yourself, use trim_prompt.

compress_file("logs/server.log")
[Usage Guru] logs/server.log
Tokens: 29,853 -> 2,969 (saved 26,884, 90.1%)
Removed: 382 repeated lines, 24 library stack
frames, 28 repeated traceback lines, ...

3

FAQ

Before you buy.

What exactly is UsageGuru?

A plugin (an MCP server) for AI coding tools, built for Claude Code. It gives your AI tools to read logs, stack traces and command output with the noise removed, so fewer tokens go into your conversation.

Does my code or data leave my machine?

Compression runs on your computer. The only thing ever sent to us is the plain-language part of a prompt you ask trim_prompt to tighten (never code or logs), and you can turn even that off.

Can it hide the error I'm looking for?

It only collapses lines that are truly repeated. Lines with different values stay, errors are never removed, and every cut leaves a marker saying what was removed.

Will it change my code?

Never. Code and source files pass through byte for byte. It also refuses to read .env files, SSH keys and other secrets.

I'm on Claude Pro or Max. Worth it?

You don't pay per token, but you do have usage limits and a context window. Smaller logs mean more work before you hit a limit, and longer sessions before the context fills up.

What happens after 700 AI rewrites?

Log compression keeps working with no limit. Only the optional AI prompt rewrite pauses until the 1st of the month.

What do I need?

Node.js 20 or newer and an AI tool that supports MCP: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code (Copilot agent mode), Windsurf, Gemini CLI and others.

How do I cancel or get a refund?

Cancel, change your card or download invoices any time in your billing portal: sign in with the email you paid with. Refunds within 7 days of your first payment, no questions asked. Just open a ticket.
